description: Flat metadata schema for individual protein–protein interaction observations generated by co-immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry in cancer cells, including experimental context, bait/prey information, detection details, and evidence/quantification fields.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record or interaction observation.

study_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to the parent study or project.

experiment_id.descr: Identifier for the specific experiment, replicate set, or MS run associated with this record.

experiment_date.descr: Date when the experiment or sample acquisition was performed, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

cell_line.descr: Cancer cell line or primary cancer cell model used, for example 'MCF-7', 'A549', or 'HeLa'.

tumor_type.descr: Cancer type or tissue context, for example breast, lung, colon, glioblastoma.

oncogenic_mutation.descr: Specific oncogenic mutation or alteration under study, for example 'KRAS G12D' or 'TP53 R175H'.

perturbation_condition.descr: Experimental perturbation applied, such as mutant expression, drug treatment, knockdown, stimulation, or control.

treatment_name.descr: Name of treatment, inhibitor, ligand, or transfection condition if applicable.

treatment_dose.descr: Dose or concentration of treatment used, with units recorded in the value when applicable.

treatment_units.descr: Units for treatment dose, for example nM, uM, mg/mL, or cells/mL.

time_post_treatment.descr: Time elapsed after treatment or perturbation, with units recorded in the value when applicable.

time_post_treatment_units.descr: Units for time after treatment, for example min, h, or d.

bait_protein_name.descr: Name of the immunoprecipitated bait protein used in the co-IP assay.

bait_gene_symbol.descr: Official gene symbol for the bait protein, for example 'EGFR' or 'BRCA1'.

bait_protein_identifier.descr: Stable identifier for the bait protein, such as UniProt accession or NCBI Gene ID.

antibody_name.descr: Name or catalog designation of the antibody used for immunoprecipitation or detection.

antibody_target.descr: Protein target recognized by the antibody.

antibody_vendor.descr: Manufacturer or supplier of the antibody.

antibody_catalog_number.descr: Vendor catalog number for the antibody.

ip_method.descr: Immunoprecipitation method used, for example co-IP, IP-MS, reciprocal IP, or affinity purification.

lysis_buffer.descr: Lysis buffer composition or name used for cell lysis and protein extraction.

crosslinking_used.descr: Indicates whether crosslinking was applied during immunoprecipitation or sample preparation.

mass_spectrometry_platform.descr: Mass spectrometry instrument or platform used, for example Orbitrap, Q Exactive, timsTOF.

ms_acquisition_mode.descr: MS acquisition mode, for example DDA, DIA, targeted MS, or PRM.

detection_method.descr: Primary detection method for interaction evidence, for example LC-MS/MS, Western blot, or both.

analysis_software.descr: Software used for peptide/protein identification or quantification, for example MaxQuant, Proteome Discoverer, Skyline.

search_database.descr: Protein sequence database used for MS identification, for example UniProt reference proteome version.

fdr_threshold.descr: False discovery rate threshold used for peptide or protein identification, expressed as a proportion such as 0.01 for 1%.

interaction_partner_name.descr: Name of the interacting protein identified in this record, also called prey or interactor.

interaction_partner_gene_symbol.descr: Official gene symbol of the interacting protein.

interaction_partner_identifier.descr: Stable identifier for the interacting protein, such as UniProt accession or NCBI Gene ID.

interaction_type.descr: Interaction category, for example direct, indirect, complex-associated, or predicted physical association.

interaction_evidence_score.descr: Quantitative confidence score for the interaction, if provided by the analysis pipeline.

peptide_count.descr: Number of unique peptides supporting identification of the interacting protein.

spectral_count.descr: Number of matched spectra supporting the interacting protein, if used.

relative_abundance.descr: Relative abundance or enrichment value for the interacting protein, such as fold enrichment or normalized intensity.

abundance_units.descr: Units for abundance or enrichment, for example fold-change, LFQ intensity, iBAQ, or arbitrary units.

significance_p_value.descr: Statistical significance value for the interaction or enrichment test.

adjusted_p_value.descr: Multiple-testing corrected p-value or q-value for the interaction or enrichment test.

log2_fold_change.descr: Log2 fold-change of interaction abundance relative to control or reference condition.

control_condition.descr: Description of the reference or control condition used for comparison.

replicate_number.descr: Biological or technical replicate number for this observation.

validated_by_orthogonal_method.descr: Indicates whether the interaction was confirmed by an orthogonal validation method such as reciprocal IP, western blot, or proximity assay.

orthogonal_validation_method.descr: Name of the validation method used, if applicable.

subcellular_location.descr: Main subcellular compartment where the interaction was observed or expected, for example nucleus, cytoplasm, membrane, mitochondrion.

pathway_context.descr: Biological pathway or signaling context relevant to the interaction, for example MAPK, PI3K/AKT, DNA repair.

cancer_progression_relevance.descr: Free-text note describing how the interaction may relate to cancer progression, invasion, survival, or therapy resistance.

therapeutic_target_potential.descr: Indicates whether the interaction or protein pair is considered a potential therapeutic target.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the record, including anomalies, caveats, or sample-specific details.
